title: Transitivity of the universal thickening and conormal sequence for formally unramified morphisms of algebraic spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For composable formally unramified morphisms of algebraic spaces over a base, the lemma gives two statements: the universal first order thickening of the composite's target base-changed along the first morphism is the universal thickening for the second, and a canonical right exact conormal sequence relates the three conormal sheaves. The proof constructs the comparison between the two universal thickenings and derives the sequence from it, using the functoriality of conormal sheaves. The construction of the comparison morphism is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 3447-3469.
